display_name: Five cross-references in the Planning and Building Law, 5725-1965, and its regulations, that do not point at what their words say, recorded as typed values with their tests: section 145ב(ב)(7)(א) citing 145(א2)(4) and 145(א3)(4), regulation 83(א) of the licensing regulations citing the repealed s 257א, the definition of respondent in the arbitrator procedure regulations citing 198א, and regulation 2(ד) of the arbitrator pay regulations citing 202(ה)(2) (four defects, two with a second reading), with three controls (s 145ב(ב)(9) citing 152(א2), the licensing regulations' enacting formula citing 145א, and the procedure regulations' definition citing 202ג); not an encoding of the Law

source.note: the consolidations are unofficial aids; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ and official/ with their page images.

expected_red.note: two assertions for defect A (one for each of its two citations), two for defect B, one for defect C as printed and one for defect D as printed, each stating what the citing words need. Section 145ב(ב)(7)(א) cites 145(א2)(4), which the consolidation does not print, and 145(א3)(4), which it prints as a different rule. Regulation 83(א) cites s 257א, which Sefer HaChukim 2635 p. 920, s 6, repealed, in force six months after publication on 25 April 2017 (p. 923, s 16(א)); the row types 26 October 2017 as the first day certain on either counting. The definition of respondent cites 198א, which the consolidation does not print, and regulation 2(ד) cites 202(ה)(2), which the consolidation does not print; the second reading of each (198(א), 202ה(2)) passes and is recorded in the tests file. The wording of s 257א was not read.

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the pages named in NOTES.md section 3 were read by the builder
